notes:
FINAL REVIEW of PR #653 (Opus 5.5 fallback for Sol), fresh full rules-clause-complete review at exact head 5905382334c2865c59c7ab1bb78d79aec5e0c36c.

Scope read: AGENTS.md, owning bead eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5 (DESIGN/AC/notes), prior reviews .2 (S1-S5) and .4 (S1), repair notes .3 and .5, full git diff origin/main...HEAD (14 files) and 86b19daa..HEAD (repair 2), all changed curated producers, regenerated records.json, finding-registry row magic-item-effects and its test, the source-agreement test. Independently enumerated the population by query (kind=magic-item with non-empty data.mechanics.effects: snapshot 213 records / 472 effects / 56 kinds, not an acceptance count) and read EVERY effect, plus every operation that delivers an effect, beside its item's printed description (records.json) and rule:wearing-and-wielding-items. Verification: magicItemEffectSourceAgreement.test.ts + findingRegistry.test.ts pass (17 tests) via npx --no-install vitest; git status clean; no edit/format/commit/push.

Prior-finding disposition: .2 S1 (natural 20 vs critical), S3 (javelin/fortress geometry), S4 (Pipes), S5 (sense/skill vocabulary) remain closed. .4 S1 named members are repaired correctly: Crystal Ball now requires touching with spell-normal casting time; Dimensional Shackles carries the portal exception; Dust of Dryness uses exposure with a single damage account and sprinkle target water. The 21 additional repair-2 fixes were each checked against the printed sentence: Amulet of the Planes, Gloves of Swimming and Climbing, Ioun Awareness, Luck Blade, Luckstone, Scarab, Sun Blade, Sword of Sharpness/Life Stealing creature target, Talisman of the Sphere, War Mage half cover, Boots of Speed, Cubic Gate, Ring of Invisibility, Plate Armor of Etherealness agree. Decanter of Endless Water and the earlier Holy Avenger repair do NOT fully agree (S1 items 4-5). The qualifier/scope class itself is still open: the sweep's claimed 'target class (creature, target, object)' and prerequisite/delivery dimensions miss confirmed members below.
S1 - BLOCKING: the local target/prerequisite/scope qualifier class is still open across represented effects, so the PR's class-sweep claim and the registry's source-agreement assertion (finding-registry.json:825) are untrue.
Invariant/authority: no emitted effect (or the operation that delivers it) may add, drop or alter a prerequisite, target, trigger, delivery or scope relative to the printed clause - owning bead eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5 DESIGN + AC1/AC3, ADR 0020 source fidelity, docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Same class as .2 S2 / .4 S1; these are NOT whole-item completeness demands - each member alters a clause that is already projected.
Members (source = item description in records.json):
1. Oathbow, magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:409-432; records.json:111663, :111669, :111680. Printed: 'When you make a RANGED attack roll WITH THIS WEAPON against your sworn enemy, you have advantage ... your target gains no benefit from cover ... If the attack hits, ... extra 3d6 piercing'. Emitted: advantage on 'attack rolls' when 'target is sworn enemy'; triggers 'attack targets sworn enemy' / 'attack hits sworn enemy'. Scenario: a melee dagger attack against the sworn enemy gets projected advantage, cover-ignore and +3d6 piercing; the source grants none and instead imposes the item's own other-weapons disadvantage (m7-oathbow-other-weapons), which the projection now cancels.
2. Rod of Lordly Might drain-life and paralyze, magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1313-1340; records.json:126149, :126163 and their operation activations :126075/:126091 ('melee hit with rod'). Printed: 'When you hit A CREATURE with a melee attack using the rod'. A melee hit on an object (door, barricade) satisfies the projection's trigger and spends the daily use. This is the exact creature-only dimension this PR repaired for Sword of Sharpness / Life Stealing.
3. Sword of Wounding c2-residual-apply-wound, magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:1180-1182; records.json:138228. Printed 'when you hit A CREATURE with an attack'; emitted trigger 'weapon attack hits' (the separate m7 operation's 'creature hit' target is not attached to this effect).
4. Vorpal Sword c2-static-vorpal-no-decapitation-rider, magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:983-991; records.json:140226. Printed 'When you attack A CREATURE that has at least one head ... Such a creature instead takes an extra 6d8'. Emitted trigger 'attack roll 20' + condition 'target cannot be decapitated'; a natural 20 against an object (which cannot be decapitated) yields 6d8 the source never grants.
5. Holy Avenger c2-residual-holy-avenger-aura-saves (rewritten by this PR), magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:299-303; records.json:105598. Printed 'YOU AND all creatures friendly to you in the aura have advantage'; emitted beneficiary 'friendly creature in drawn-sword aura' drops the wielder.
6. Decanter of Endless Water c2-residual-geyser-impact (rewritten by repair 2), magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:840-846; records.json:96660. Printed 'As a bonus action WHILE HOLDING THE DECANTER, you can aim the geyser at a creature YOU CAN SEE within 30 feet ... pushed up to 15 feet away FROM YOU'. Emitted trigger drops the holding prerequisite and the sight requirement (the decanter is not a weapon/worn item, so rule:wearing-and-wielding-items supplies no default) and the push origin. Scenario: decanter set down on a table, geyser aimed at an unseen creature - admitted by the projection, forbidden by the source.
7. Ring of Shooting Stars c2-launch-shooting-stars-payload, magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:656-670; records.json:122002 (operation has no target). Printed 'at a point YOU CAN SEE within 60 feet'; emitted only rangeFeet 60. A point behind total cover/in magical darkness is admitted.
8. Dagger of Venom operation coat-blade (delivers c2-coat-blade-payload), magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:130; records.json:96137. Printed 'You can use an action to cause thick, black poison to coat the blade' (no prerequisite). Emitted activation requirement 'dagger is coated' - an invented prerequisite that contradicts the item's own stateMachine (coat-blade transitions uncoated->coated), making the delivery of the payload unreachable from the initial state. Same operation-activation stage this PR repaired for Cubic Gate and the prior repair for Gloves of Missile Snaring.
Sibling analysis (all hit/attack triggers, beneficiary sets, possession prerequisites, sight requirements, effect-delivering activations re-read): agreeing - Dagger of Venom payload ('hits a creature'), Giant Slayer/Dragon Slayer/Mace of Disruption/Sun Blade/Holy Avenger riders (typed creatures), Staff of Power/Striking/Withering, Flame Tongue, Frost Brand (printed 'any target'/'the target'/'on a hit'), Vicious Weapon and Mace of Smiting (no printed target class), Rod of Alertness sense, Ring of the Ram/Rope/Wand of Paralysis/Gem of Brightness/Rod terrify/Iron Flask (sight kept). Possession prerequisites on weapons/shields/worn items are covered by rule:wearing-and-wielding-items (see NOT A FINDING).
Closure: repair all eight through the curated producers (keep each qualifier on the effect/operation stage it governs), regenerate pack + inventory, correct the registry reasoning, and extend the existing generalized scope assertions with representative cases for: weapon-and-attack-mode scope (Oathbow), creature-only hit triggers across all hit-rider siblings, beneficiary inclusion of the wielder, non-weapon possession + sight prerequisites, and effect-delivering activation requirements that must not contradict the item's state machine. Repair material: YES (rules semantics + claimed completion); fresh full review at the new head.
S2 - BLOCKING: Nine Lives Stealer charge expenditure is made unconditional, although the printed rule makes it conditional on the creature being slain.
Invariant/authority: no altered quantity or trigger (owning bead DESIGN/AC1, ADR 0020, importer-fix protocol). Location: magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1488-1500 (its own sourcePhrases quote 'sword loses 1 charge if the creature is slain'); records.json:111425 (c2-slay-on-critical-payload chargeCost: 1, no condition) and operation slay-on-critical records.json:~111419 (cost charges 1 on activation trigger 'critical hit against eligible creature'; producer magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:305).
Scenario: critical hit on a 60-HP ogre that SUCCEEDS on the DC 15 Constitution save - the projection spends a charge; the SRD spends none. A sword at 1 charge thus loses the property after a failed kill.
Sibling analysis: other on-trigger costs re-read - Arrow of Slaying (use spent once extra damage dealt; matches 'once it deals its extra damage'), Staff of Striking/Power, Scarab, Rod of Lordly Might daily uses, Wand of Binding - all spend on the printed event. No other conditional-expenditure misreading found.
Closure: make the payload's charge cost and the operation's charge expenditure conditional on the slain outcome (or route expenditure through the failed-save branch), regenerate, and add a representative assertion. Repair material: YES; fresh full review.

NOT A FINDING: static benefits printed 'while you hold' on weapons, staffs used as weapons and shields (Frost Brand, Staff of Fire/Frost/Power/Magi/Woodlands, Spellguard, Defender AC, Shield +N) - rule:wearing-and-wielding-items sets the default ('A weapon must be held', 'a shield strapped to the arm'); the repairer's judgment is source-backed.
NOT A FINDING: Glamoured Studded Leather operations cost 'action' vs printed bonus action - those operations deliver no effect, so they are outside this bead's effect population; worth a separate bead, no requirement here.
NOT A FINDING: Rod of Rulership / Talisman of the Sphere / Rod of Alertness unrepresented clauses or target fields - whole-item clause completeness, no requirement.
NOT A FINDING: Wand of the War Mage half cover under 'holder' - 'In addition' extends the printed holding condition; agrees.
NOT A FINDING: whole-item completeness, engine execution, zero engine-pending entries, per-effect permanent tests - no requirement (as .2/.4).
NOT A FINDING: occurrence screen cannot see scope relationships - DESIGN assigns that to semantic review + representative assertions.
NOT A FINDING: carpet normal-capacity multiplier exception and the registry identity text - unchanged, source-backed.
